 The Trail Blazers host the Oklahoma City Thunder in the first of a back to back in Portland, and Schultzy has your instant reaction on the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST! How will the Blazers respond after two tough loses to the Lakers and Spurs? Can Donovan Clingan get back to dominating the paint while Deni Avdija and Damian Lillard take care of the ball ? Join the Locked On Blazers POSTCAST right after the final buzzer!
